razao: FloorTile is a highly challenging domain due to dead-ends created by painting tiles, which block future robot movement. Modern portfolio planners like Fast Downward Stone Soup 2023 combine diverse configurations and state-of-the-art search algorithms, maximizing the chance of coverage on domains with complex constraints and dead-ends.
